title: Safe Failure Analysis Transfer: Applying Fail-Safe Design Principles from Aerospace to AI Monitor Defaults
original_idea: Enumerate ways a monitoring system can fail (LLM unavailable, context window exceeded, rate limit, contradictions). For each failure mode, analyze if default behavior is fail-safe or fail-dangerous. Design fail-safe alternatives. Evaluate impact on task completion in ControlArena.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Excellent theory: fail-safe analysis is fundamental safety engineering. Identifying cases where monitors fail-dangerous and designing fail-safe alternatives directly prevents catastrophic undetected misbehavior. Clear, actionable, high-impact.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Primarily logical analysis plus some software modification. No ML needed. Enumerating failure modes and analyzing defaults is accessible. Implementing fail-safe alternatives in ControlArena requires some framework knowledge but is feasible. Fits in 30hrs.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Enumerating failure modes is open-ended (how many are there?). Each failure mode needs analysis AND an alternative implementation AND evaluation. The scope could expand. Moderately bounded.
